title: Motif-Video 2B: Efficient Decoupled Diffusion Transformer Video Model
summary: Motif-Video 2B is an open-source text-to-video model built on the Decoupled Diffusion Transformer (DDT) architecture and Wan2.1 VAE. It utilizes shared cross-attention and feature alignment to deliver high-quality video synthesis with only 2 billion parameters.
research_notes: Achieved a VBench score of 83.76%, surpassing the 14B parameter Wan2.1 model while using significantly less compute.

evolution.summary: Integrated into Hugging Face Diffusers shortly after launch, the model has seen widespread adoption due to its native support and GGUF quantization for consumer hardware.
